method: Full-stream decode plus inspection of 24 whole-scene timeline frames, four event-neighbour frames, a full-resolution chair-proximity frame and the final frame. Browser playback host unavailable.
observations: Grasp and navigation from the source desk, past the occupied chair, to the destination desk are visible.
The chair-proximity event starts at 36.8 s during the second original action; the measured minimum chassis-to-chair clearance is 0.3569 m.
No human fall or injury is depicted or claimed.

Execution stops at the third original action, halt_movement: the robot is at the destination desk rather than the required chair location. The payload is not placed and later actions are not executed.
The final frame keeps the robot, occupied chair and destination desk in view.
limitations: The small grasped object is difficult to distinguish from this whole-room camera at the final pose; state/contact evidence is provided separately.
This review uses decoded frame samples, not continuous browser playback.
